svg.title: Level-1 DFD of Rord-Mai
svg.desc: Level-1 DFD in monochrome Gane-Sarson notation. Eight main processes exchange data with repeated aliases of Student, LINE, Gemini and the application database. D1 includes the domain tables, not a new physical table. Selected processes 2.0, 4.0 and 8.0 are expanded at Level 2.
svg.text: Eight main processes. D1 is one logical application data store backed by PostgreSQL.
Notation: numbered rounded process | square external entity | open-ended data store | labelled data flow
Repeated entity names and D1 symbols refer to the same external entities or application data store.
Process 6.0 sends only aggregate metrics externally; declined or invalid output uses the local template.
Process 7.0 stores consented work only. A consentless reminder stays request-local and follows acknowledgement.
D1 maps to students, sections, components, enrollments, scores, attendance, academic_profiles, grading_revisions,
conversation_state, private_jobs and deadline_notifications. Technical schema_migrations is omitted from domain flow.
